messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up 10: CloudBridge (SI) wants a turnkey observability kit for Redwood Private deployments they can roll out for enterprise customers. They asked for Datadog + OTLP examples, GPU metrics mapping, and a playbook for controlling ingestion costs. Goal: have an installable bundle and a co-branded one-pager for their docs by May.
Evan Ross: Sounds sensible. Main risks are metric cardinality from model_id tags and traces from high-volume inference. We should provide sampling knobs and an example of using Datadog ingest controls.
Jamie Liu: For dashboards, I'd split into 3 dashboards: infra (GPU/hosts), model perf (latency/p99, cold vs warm), and cost (ingestion, token counts). Include both metric and trace correlations.
Nico Ortega: On GPU metrics: NVIDIA DCGM exports sm_util, fb_used, encoder/decoder metrics. We should map them to readable names in the quickstart and provide a Prometheus job + OTEL collector config.
Maya Patel: CloudBridge also asked for an optional APM span contract: span.kind, model_id, model_version, shard_id, request_tier, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cache_hit. They want a small schema to validate spans before export.
Evan Ross: Agree. We'll provide a span attribute whitelist middleware and a sample validator. Also include an example of exporting low-cardinality attributes only to Datadog and sending full attributes to an internal S3 tracer archive for audits.
Jamie Liu: Packaging: propose a ZIP with 
- OTEL collector config (datadog + file exporter)
- Datadog dashboard JSONs (infra, model, cost)
- quickstart README with ingestion-control tips
- co-branded one-pager for CloudBridge
We can host the ZIP from our docs site and the Marketplace listing links to it.
Maya Patel: Timeline: draft kit by 2026-04-18, internal review 4/21, CloudBridge review 4/28, legal & marketing signoff by 5/06, soft launch 5/12. Anyone blocked?
Datadog Bot: Datadog engineering: we can supply dashboard templates and a recommended ingestion control snippet. ETA for templates: 2026-04-12. We'll also provide notes on APM billing for high-span-volume services.
Evan Ross: Putting a recommended OTEL collector snippet here for metrics + traces, with sampling and resource detection:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
processors:
  resource:
  batch:
  sampling:
    tail:
      decision_wait: 10s
      probability: 0.02
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: model_id
        action: hash
      - key: model_version
        action: insert
        value: "${MODEL_VERSION}"
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
  file:
    path: /var/log/otel_traces.ndjson
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [resource, sampling, batch, attributes]
      exporters: [datadog, file]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [resource, batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Evan Ross: Note the sampling probability is intentionally low; adjust per-customer. The attributes processor hashes model_id to reduce cardinality for metrics, but we recommend keeping plain model_id on file export for later forensic analysis.
Nico Ortega: For DCGM mapping, include a small table in the README:
- dcgm_sm_util -> gpu.sm_util
- dcgm_fb_used -> gpu.memory_used_bytes
- dcgm_power_draw -> gpu.power_watts
Also include a short shell script to scrape DCGM + push to OTEL collector.
Jamie Liu: Marketing wants a 2-slide demo: 1) high-level flow of request -> trace -> dashboard, 2) cost-control checklist and recommended customer settings. Can someone draft slides?
Maya Patel: I'll draft the slides and the co-branded one-pager. @Jamie can you assemble dashboard screenshots. @Evan please repo the OTEL config and the span validator; add tests.
Jamie Liu: Will add screenshots and a lightweight raw-dashboard that works with sampled telemetry (so customers don't need full ingestion to see functionality).
Datadog Bot: Also reminder: include links to Datadog ingestion controls and billing docs in the kit. Recommend customers use APM retention and sampling settings to cap month-over-month costs.
Evan Ross: Action items placed in the shared tracker: https://brief.link/rw-cloudbridge-kit. Weekly check-in Thursdays 11am PT starting 2026-03-25.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. CloudBridge kickoff is next Monday; I'll bring the draft one-pager.
